name: Moctezuma

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Shield Multiplier +30%, DMG Multiplier +30%, DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%
Attunement Multiplier +40%, Armor Multiplier +25%, Weapon Multiplier +25%
Awaken the ability: Dance of Tenochtitlan

description: Moctezuma is a powerful Defender who punishes enemies with Barriers and Shields, protecting his allies while reflecting damage back at his foes.
lore: The greatest Aztec Emperor who expanded his kingdom and made Tenochtitlan the jewel of his world. Empowered by the divine aether released after the Shattering, Moctezuma has become akin to a god. He is one of Omeyocan’s staunchest defenders, wary of other Realms and determined to protect his people against invasion.
imprint_passive: When an enemy attacks this hero, decrease the damage received by 10% and increase the damage this hero inflicts on their next ability by 2.5%. This is doubled if the enemy is under [Barrier] or [Shield].

skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (95%DEF+90%ATK) 2 times. Each hit inflicts 50% increased damage to [Barrier] and [Shield]. If the target is not under [Barrier] and [Shield] increase this hero’s Turn Meter by 10% instead.
skills.name: Obsidian Judgement

skills.description: Attack all enemies (80%DEF+75%ATK) 2 times. Before each hit, has a 75% chance to remove [Barrier] and [Shield] from each target. If the target is not under [Barrier] or [Shield] after attacking, has a 75% chance to place [Curse II] on each target for 2 turns otherwise place [Acid] on each target for 2 turns. Also place [Taunt] on each target for 1 turn.
skills.name: Moctezuma’s Revenge
Dance of Tenochtitlan
skills.description: Place [Ward] on all allies for 2 turns, then attack all enemies (145%DEF+130%ATK). Also place [Shield] on all allies equal to 30% of the damage inflicted. The [Shield] cannot exceed 25,000.
skills.awakening_bonus: Increase the [Shield] limit to 50,000 and reflects 100% of the damage inflicted to the shield. This will always be a Normal hit and ignore 100% DEF.

skills.description: When an enemy attacks an ally, decrease the damage received by 20% and increase the damage this hero inflicts on their next ability by 5%. This is doubled if the enemy is under [Barrier] or [Shield].
skills.name: Sacrificial Vow
skills.awakening_bonus: If an ally is defeated, activate this hero’s Core Ability.

subtitle: The Conqueror
